summary: Climber Dave Cook missing in the Maroon Bells since September 2016; on 2017-09-27 three volunteer teams (MRA + Colorado Forensic Canines, 3 HRD dogs) searched Fravert basin, Lost Remuda basin, and the Amphitheater near Pyramid Peak; nothing found.
location: Maroon Bells (Fravert basin, Lost Remuda basin, Pyramid Peak Amphitheater)
notes: Source: Mountain Rescue Aspen Facebook page. Date approximate (missing since September 2016).
